00071 UGen XFadeLoopPlayBufUGenInternal::OnsetLoopXFade::spawnEvent(TrigXFadeUGenInternal& spawn, 
00072                                                               const int eventCount, 
00073                                                               void* extraArgs)
00074 {

00076         return PlayBuf::AR(getOwner()->soundOnset, getOwner()->inputs[XFadeLoopPlayBufUGenInternal::Rate], 0, 0, 0);

00083 XFadeLoopPlayBufUGenInternal::XFadeLoopPlayBufUGenInternal(XFadeLoopSpec const& spec, UGen const& rate)
00084 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, spec.getNumChannels() - 1),
00085     fadeTime(spec.getFadeTime()),
00086     startLoop(spec.getStartLoop()),
00087     endLoop(spec.getEndLoop()),
00088     soundOnset(spec.getSoundOnset()),
00089     soundLoop(spec.getSoundLoop()),
00090     bufferData(new float*[spec.getNumChannels()])
00091 {
00092     inputs[Rate] = rate;
00093     
00094     float startLoopRate = UGen::getSampleRate() / startLoop;
00095     UGen trig = Impulse::AR(startLoopRate * rate);
00096     
00097     const int maxRepeats = 2;
00098     graph = TrigXFade<OnsetLoopXFade, XFadeLoopPlayBufUGenInternal>::AR(spec.getNumChannels(), 
00099                                                                         trig, 
00100                                                                         ugen::max(fadeTime, 0.05f), 
00101                                                                         maxRepeats,
00102                                                                         this);
00103 }

00110 void XFadeLoopPlayBufUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00111 {   
00112     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();  
00113     const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00114     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00115     {
00116         bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00117     }
00118     
00119     graph.prepareForBlock(numSamplesToProcess, blockID);
00120     graph.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamplesToProcess, numChannels);
00121     graph.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00122 }
